note: The four ways of answering a question, from AN 4.42. The Dhamma surface classifies every question into one of these modes before generating, and shows the mode on the answer card. Glosses are for the UI label; ne strings await a native-speaker pass.

explain.en: A single, clear answer the sources support: yes, no, this, that.
explain.ne: स्रोतहरूले समर्थन गर्ने एउटै स्पष्ट उत्तर: हो, होइन, यो, त्यो।

explain.en: The question needs a term defined or a distinction drawn before it can be answered fairly.
explain.ne: यसको न्यायपूर्ण उत्तर दिनुअघि कुनै शब्द परिभाषित गर्नु वा भेद छुट्याउनु आवश्यक छ।

explain.en: The question is about your own situation, not doctrine, so it is turned back for you to work through.
explain.ne: यो प्रश्न सिद्धान्तबारे होइन, तपाईंकै अवस्थाबारे हो, त्यसैले तपाईंले नै विचार गर्न फर्काइन्छ।

explain.en: Some questions are left unanswered on purpose: either outside the canon we hold, or of the kind the Buddha himself declined.
explain.ne: केही प्रश्न जानाजान अनुत्तरित छाडिन्छन्: या त हामीसँग भएको ग्रन्थभन्दा बाहिरका, या बुद्ध आफैंले अस्वीकार गर्नुभएका खालका।

modes.declined_example: Cūḷamālukya Sutta, Majjhima Nikāya 63: the ten questions the Buddha set aside.
